blind.description: A stylized carved stone sarcophagus or tomb with an open, diagonally rotated lid resting across one end. The main coffin base is rectangular with paneled sides decorated with raised circular medallions and pilasters. The lid has a pitched/gabled top featuring a carved sunburst/winged emblem. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and painted with an aged, weathered tan/beige sandstone texture. The interior of the basin is hollow and empty. It rests flat on the floor without any added display plinth.
blind.from_above: A rectangular hollow stone box aligned vertically, with a rectangular carved stone lid resting across the upper half at roughly a 45-degree counterclockwise angle, partially revealing the dark hollow interior below.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2 ft high to the top of the lid), with a length slightly less than half the figure's height (around 2.5 to 3 ft long) and width around 1.5 ft.
